description: Source code for TrueType subpixel hinting in the FreeType project, including font class rules, hinting rules, and tweak functions for glyph rendering adjustments.

methods.name: sph_test_tweak
methods.description: Checks if a glyph matches any tweak rule based on font family, style, size, and glyph index.

methods.name: sph_test_tweak_x_scaling
methods.description: Determines the scaling factor for a glyph based on font family, style, and size.

methods.name: sph_set_tweaks
methods.description: Applies various hinting tweaks to a glyph based on predefined rules and font properties.
